Oh sorry, I missed that. So you want something with time on the x
axis, count on the y-axis, coloured by career? I'd start by counting
the number of classes in each block (assuming your table is called
events):

times <- seq(8, 22, by = 1/4)
blocks <- ldply(times, function(hour) {
cur <- subset(events, start_hour <= hour & end_hour > hour)
data.frame(hour = hour, table(career = cur$career))
})

qplot(hour, Freq, data = blocks, fill = career, geom = "area")

Hadley
